messages.subject: [rkward-users] RKWard presentation & new rkwarddev release
messages.body_plain:
hi,

as mentioned earlier, we presented RKWard a few days ago at the TeaP (the 
second largest psychological conference in the german speaking area, although 
english is the primary conference language now). there was a symposium with 
five talks dedicated to R, and we started the session with RKWard (i stepped 
in, since unfortunately, thomas couldn't be there as planned). the room was 
packed with people standing, which was a bit of a pleasant surprise because we 
actually got the worst of all possible time slots: 9 o'clock in the morning 
after the conference dinner ;-) it went really well, we should do this more 
often to get more attention.

you can download the presentation slides of that session via the open science 
framework:
 https://osf.io/view/teap2015/

i didn't manage to get the new rkwarddev package released in time for the 
conference, but did so yesterday. it has quite an impressive number of changes 
and improvements, so i raised the version number to 0.07-1:
 http://files.kde.org/rkward/R/pckg/rkwarddev/NEWS.html
it's actually 0.07-2 already, because i forgot to replace all the obsolete 
sourceforge URLs.


viele grüße :: m.eik


-- 
  dipl. psych. meik michalke
  institut f"ur experimentelle psychologie
  abt. f"ur diagnostik und differentielle psychologie
  heinrich-heine-universit"at d-40204 d"usseldorf

messages.subject: [rkward-users] RKWard in other languages
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
In Windows 7 operating system.
I waited to version 0.6.3 of RKWard, where it was announced that would be fully translatable.
When installing the new version, it is still in English. 
I searched inside the installation folder KDE / translations and I have not found any file that references the Spanish.
I have been searching the internet and I have not located any file to download with the Spanish language.
What is the procedure?
Thank You
      De: Thomas Friedrichsmeier <thomas.friedrichsmeier at ruhr-uni-bochum.de>
 Para: Iván Artalejo <ivan.artalejo at yahoo.es> 
CC: "rkward-users at kde.org" <rkward-users at kde.org> 
 Enviado: Martes 24 de febrero de 2015 14:37
 Asunto: Re: [rkward-users] RKWard in other languages
   
Hi!



On Tue, 24 Feb 2015 11:31:21 +0000 (UTC)
Iván Artalejo <ivan.artalejo at yahoo.es> wrote:
> How can I install RKWard in other languages, for example spanish?

Before everything else: Language support will be _much_ better in the
upcoming RKWard 0.6.3 (expected in less than two weeks). If you'd tell
us which platform you're on, we could give you instructions for
installing a preview release of 0.6.3. 

Other than that, the answer will still depend on what platform you are
using, and possibly on how you are installing:

- Linux / MacOS:
All available translations should already be included in your
installation. RKWard 0.6.3 included "es", but "ca" was de-activated
due to being too incomplete. To test that translations are actually
working, start RKWard as
  KDE_LANG=de rkward
(the "de" translation is comparatively complete in 0.6.2).
- Windows:
The binaries for RKWard up to 0.6.2 did not include any translations,
yet. The upcoming binaries for 0.6.3 will include translations. The
existing 0.6.3-pre2 installer already does.

Regards
Thomas

messages.subject: [rkward-users] RKWard in other languages
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Sat, 14 Mar 2015 17:25:47 +0000 (UTC)
Iván Artalejo <ivan.artalejo at yahoo.es> wrote:
> In Windows 7 operating system.
> I waited to version 0.6.3 of RKWard, where it was announced that
> would be fully translatable. When installing the new version, it is
> still in English. I searched inside the installation folder KDE /
> translations and I have not found any file that references the
> Spanish. I have been searching the internet and I have not located
> any file to download with the Spanish language. What is the
> procedure?

I am not sure, why this does not work for you out of the box, sorry
about this. Is your Windows OS localized to Spanish? Either way, the
following should do the trick:

Open a command window, run
  cd C:\Your\RKWard\Installation\KDE\bin
  SET KDE_LANG=es
  rkward.exe
Tested and works in a Win7 virtual machine. Consider putting this in
a .bat file for now, or set the KDE_LANG environment variable to es,
permanently (Control Panel->System->Advanced->Environment Variables).

In fact, I do note that translations for system messages are missing,
in the binary bundle installation, though. I'll have to think about how
to fix this (probably this can only be done using a separate download,
after all). If you want to fix this for yourself, today, you'll have
to:

  1. Download the KDE on Windows installer:
http://winkde.org/pub/kde/ports/win32/installer/kdewin-installer-gui-1.0.0.exe
  2. Run this, point it to the "KDE"-folder inside your existing RKWard
  installation (C:\Your\RKWard\Installation\KDE)
  3. All other settings should be ok, simply click "Next"
  4. Click "language packs", and install "es".
  5. I am not sure, whether you will now see the Spanish version,
  automatically, whenever starting RKWard, or whether you will still
  have to follow the above procedure of setting KDE_LANG. Feedback on
  this would be appreciated!

Once again, sorry about the inconvenience. I had - wrongly - expected
this to "just work". I'll try to come up with a proper solution as time
allows.

Regards
Thomas

P.S.: The translation files for RKWard itself are installed in
  KDE\share\locale\*\LC_MESSAGES\rkward.mo
and
  KDE\share\apps\rkward\po\*
inside your installation folder.
